d: Swissotel Al Ghurair & Swissotel Living Al Ghurair Hotel is a 620-room-and-suite upper upscale property. Catering for both business and leisure clientele. The hotel is located in Deira in the heart of Dubai and within easy reach of major tourist landmarks, leisure destinations and city services. It is linked to the Al Ghurair Shopping Centre, only 3 stops away on the Dubai Metro from the Dubai World Trade Centre and a 10-minute drive from Dubai International Airport.

As a Director of Revenue, you will be entrusted with the responsibility of maximizing revenue and optimizing profitability across all revenue streams. You will play a pivotal role in developing and implementing strategies to ensure the hotel achieves its financial objectives while maintaining its esteemed reputation for excellence in hospitality.
Employee benefit card offering discounted rates in Accor worldwide
Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world!
Ability to make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities
q: Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field (Master's degree preferred).
Proven experience in revenue management or related roles within the hospitality industry, preferably in luxury or 5-star hotels.
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in revenue management systems and data analytics tools.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams.
Strategic mindset with the ability to think creatively and develop innovative revenue strategies.
Results-oriented with a track record of achieving revenue targets and driving profitability.
Knowledge of industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies in revenue management.
Please note that you must be eligible to live and work in Dubai. Swissotel Al Ghurair & Swissotel Living Al Ghurair will cover visa costs and flights for selected candidates from place of origin.
r: Develop and execute comprehensive revenue management strategies to drive revenue growth and achieve financial targets
Analyze market trends, competitor performance, and economic factors to make informed pricing and inventory decisions.
Implement dynamic pricing strategies to maximize revenue per available room (RevPAR) and other key performance indicators.
Oversee distribution channels including direct bookings, online travel agencies (OTAs), global distribution systems (GDS), and other distribution partners.
Monitor channel performance and adjust distribution strategies to optimize revenue and minimize distribution costs.
Negotiate contracts and partnerships with distribution partners to enhance the hotel's visibility and reach.
Develop accurate revenue forecasts based on historical data, market trends, and upcoming events.
Collaborate with department heads to establish annual budgets and revenue targets.
Monitor performance against budget and forecast, identifying variances and implementing corrective actions as necessary.
Utilize data analytics tools to extract insights and identify revenue optimization opportunities.
Prepare regular reports and presentations for senior management, highlighting key performance metrics, trends, and actionable recommendations.
Collaborate closely with sales, marketing, and operations teams to align revenue strategies with overall business objectives.
Provide guidance and support to department heads in implementing revenue optimization initiatives.
Foster a culture of revenue management excellence throughout the organization.

d: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

We are seeking a dynamic and proactive Senior or Supervising Associate to strengthen EY’s employer brand across MENA. The role will support the development and delivery of audience focused employer brand communications and engagement strategies that attract talent, from students and graduates to experienced professionals. Working closely with recruitment, marketing and global employer brand teams, the successful candidate will turn market insights into compelling content, campaigns and experiences that showcase EY’s culture and career opportunities. The role will also monitor EY’s digital reputation, strengthen our presence across social media and career channels, and empower our people to share authentic employer brand stories.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field.
five to ten years of experience in marketing, employer branding, recruitment marketing, communications or a related field.
Demonstrated experience using LinkedIn for organic content, campaigns, advocacy or talent attraction.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders and deadlines simultaneously.
Strong organizational skills, sound judgement and the ability to deliver high quality work in a fast paced corporate environment.
A passion for creativity and a drive to develop innovative ideas.
Strong knowledge of social media platforms and their role in employer branding and marketing.
Ability to develop creative, audience focused marketing strategies and campaigns.
Ability to analyze data and metrics to evaluate performance and inform improvements.
Ability to lead initiatives independently and contribute effectively as part of a collaborative team.
r: Support the development, localization and delivery of the global employer branding strategy, aligned with priority growth areas, talent needs and EY’s culture.
Translate the Employee Value Proposition into clear and compelling messaging across social media, programs, events and recruitment channels.
Plan and deliver integrated marketing campaigns that strengthen the employer brand and support priority talent attraction needs.
Apply strong knowledge of social media platforms, with particular expertise in LinkedIn, to reach and engage priority audiences.
Use internal and external social listening tools to produce weekly insights, identify reputation trends and recommend practical actions.
Oversee the careers website experience, optimizing content for candidates, search visibility and AI enabled discovery.
Partner with the campus recruitment team to identify content opportunities around upcoming career events.
Develop attraction communications and engagement strategies aligned with recruitment priorities.
Shape the employer branding approach for in person and virtual career events, ensuring a consistent and engaging candidate experience.
Contribute to the employer brand newsletter to increase awareness of initiatives, resources and opportunities for colleagues to participate.
Deliver practical LinkedIn guidance and training that equips teams to act as confident employer brand advocates.
Partner with colleague advocates and subject matter contributors to create and amplify authentic EY content.
Work with recruitment teams and relevant stakeholders to increase the visibility of priority vacancies on LinkedIn.
Manage and evolve the Talent Brand Ambassadors program, enabling colleagues to share credible and consistent employer brand stories.
Track and report on key performance indicators, including digital reputation, campaign engagement and channel performance, and recommend improvements based on the findings.
Monitor competitor employer branding and recruitment activity, candidate expectations and relevant industry trends to identify opportunities.

d: To support Inflight Services operations at Base as well as outstation network and ensure that standards are maintained and policies are adhered to at catering centers. To be responsible for operating the Inflight Services ACSI, Sabre and Soymeal system by entering meal uplifts & catering equipment required accurately, and identifying areas on how to reduce costs, enhancing efficiency and minimizing wastage of catering services.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Catering, Hospitality, Aviation, or a related field.
Fluent in written and spoken English, with good numerical skills.
Basic computer literacy, preferably Microsoft Office
0-2 years of experience in catering or a related field.
If you meet the criteria and you are enthusiastic about the role, we would welcome your application. To complete the application you would need the following document(s):
Ensure that all on or off schedule, flights are catered and equipped to GF standards, at Base and for return sectors.
Physically check, verify the equipment loading and off-loading on aircraft, production materials and prepare uplift for all GF flights.
Liaise with specific outstations for extra or off schedule operations and arrange uplifts accordingly and arrange retrieval of all surplus GF equipment.
Ensure that all return sector flights catered EX-BAH are email advised for the actual catering on board.

Constantly monitor operational changes in ACSI system / Email relating to delays and cancellation of flights. Network wise caterers need to be advised to revise their catering accordingly, prompt action is required to avoid caterers charging GF for cancelled meal uplift.
Check, record and save all final catering figures supplied by caterers into Skymeal and ACSI system.

Due to Cargo constraints, liaise with caterers to cabin load items in small quantity by re-packing equipment in meal carts and forward to out-stations to ensure flights service disruptions. This function is carried out by liaising with BAH Customs for their approval and necessary email advice sent to concerned stations.
Highlight any visible food specification or standard/ hygiene requirements that are seen as obviously irregular to the Products, Hygiene and Standards department.

Responsible for ensuring that all the products provided by catering contractors are prepared, stored and transported onboard the aircraft and are of hygienically accepted standards and conditions. Any deviations noted must be recorded, reported and measures taken to correct the situation with full report forwarded to HQ.
Raise, receive, verify, and control direct orders, ensuring specifications are met, expiry dates are recorded on invoices, and delivered items undergo quality checks.
Ensure caterers adhere to Gulf Air standards regarding meal and equipment quality.

Liaise with Catering Contractor at BAH station to ensure they understand and fulfill their catering service level obligations and ensure monthly stock returns are provided to ensure company’s interest is maintained.
Support wider Inflight Services department through liaison with flight attendants, airports, engineering and cleaning departments on shift for regular review of operations that may be required.
Verify laundry quantities and coordinate with the caterer and laundry service to ensure sufficient quantities onboard.

Check and take immediate appropriate action on all mail/telex correspondence, monitor ACSI/ Sabre and Skymeal system for numerous flights pax figures/ special meals/ catering estimates and respond to all urgent communications.
Establish system to reduce meal wastage to the minimum by liaising closely with GF RESV/ Ground Services/ Catering Contractors and effective utilization of ACSI and Sabre system.
Control actual usage and misuse if any of GF assets, stored material at catering unit by implementing and maintaining proper storage and Bin Cards/ AirServ Inventory for issues and receipts.
Arrange and forward relevant Menu and Wine Cards to respective catering stations as per Menu cycle rotations if needed.
Certify catering invoices (Approx. BD300,000/ month) by caterers by physically checking all ordered meal count and other ancillary services provided for GF flight with supporting documents.
Submit shift report to Catering Operations Controller highlighting review of target issues, offload analysis report, areas of discussion with other departments and any shortages.
Maintain, understand Inflight Services manuals and oversee knowledge of GF products in catering station.
Perform any other tasks assignments and projects deemed necessary by Bahrain Headquarters.
Conduct any task as assigned by the by Management in the related field.

d: TalentScript is recruiting on behalf of a Kuwait-based holding company seeking an experienced IT Specialist to oversee the smooth operation, security, and maintenance of technology systems across its head office and other locations.
We are looking for a hands-on professional with strong technical skills across access control, CCTV, telephony, networking, and IT support.
q: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in IT support, troubleshooting, and systems maintenance.
Required hands-on experience with access control (biometrics, access points), telephony, CCTV, and backup/recovery solutions.
Strong knowledge of hardware, networking, and operating systems (Windows, macOS).
Experience with Office 365 administration, firewalls, servers, and ERP systems.
Certifications such as CompTIA Network+, Security+, CCNA, or MCSA are preferred.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and time-management skills, with a proactive, customer-centric approach.
We welcome applications from professionals currently working as
Infrastructure or Security Systems Technicians with broader IT support experience
r: Maintain and troubleshoot access control systems, including biometric and facial recognition scanners, and manage user credentials and permissions.
Support telephony systems, including VoIP, phone lines, call routing, and mobile devices.
Maintain and monitor CCTV cameras and recording systems, and protect surveillance data and footage.
Manage backup and recovery processes, and regularly test and document disaster recovery plans.
Provide first-level technical support for hardware, software, network, email, and user account issues.
Maintain and optimize network infrastructure, including routers, switches, Wi-Fi, and internet connectivity.
Implement IT security measures such as antivirus, firewalls, and access controls, and address vulnerabilities proactively.
Manage IT asset inventory, documentation, and reporting.
Coordinate with IT and access control vendors and track SLA compliance.
Train employees on new systems, cybersecurity awareness, and IT onboarding for new hires.
Provide administrative support, including procurement, document control, and coordinating high-level meetings and reporting packs.
